findings.resolution: Cold imports now reserve a provenance entry in the existing bounded shared cache before dispatch. Provenance stores owner and conversation. Other overlapping imports reject before upstream contact. Staged commit revalidates exclusive reservation identity synchronously with atomic batch publication. Preparation failures, signal abort, consumer cancellation and failed publication release only their own pending entries; successful commits replace pending entries with permanent scoped provenance.
findings.behavior: An overlapping cold import of an already pending signature is rejected, including the same scope, until the first attempt commits or releases. After successful commit only exact replay in the recorded owner/conversation is accepted.
